pillar_b_first_principles_investigation.root_cause_summary:
1. Broken O(4) Rotational Invariance (P16-H5 & all worlds): SVD of isotropic latent grid P in {-1,+1}^4 returns an arbitrary orthogonal rotation Q in O(4). In rotated coordinates Z = P Q, cross-products p_0*p_1 project onto diagonal quadratic terms z_k^2 (sum_k Q_{0k} Q_{1k} z_k^2). Because v1 _compute_phi(Z) omitted z_k^2, it suffered up to 75x source retention inflation on non-axis-aligned seeds (mean ret=0.0187, 6/10 < 0.02).
2. Noisy 20-Shot Normalizer Refit (P16-H2): v1 adapt_few_shot overwrote x_mean on 20 noisy target draws even when align_sensors=False, shifting Z by ||dx||~0.45 and exploding var(y - y_core) by up to 333x (36.6 -> 12,211), causing core_gate to falsely turn OFF on 8/10 seeds of W16_shared_plus_new.
3. Unconditioned Stiefel GD & Rank-Deficient Fixed Ridge (P16-H1, P16-H3, P16-H4): Unnormalized GD on 32-DOF W_adapter failed to align W16_obs_shift (10/10 gate OFF), while fixed lambda=0.05 on 20 draws with replacement (~11 unique corners) overfit unseen corners (up to 0.526 nRMSE).
pillar_b_first_principles_investigation.first_principles_solution: Upgraded ModularTransferModel in models/transfer.py with: (1) complete O(K)-invariant degree-2 basis Phi_full(Z) including diagonal z_k^2 (14 features, 66 total params — 12.6x fewer than 833-param MLP); (2) preserved _source_x_mean for unshifted worlds and subspace-restricted O(K) Adam + polar SVD retraction across balanced det(R)=+/-1 restarts for sensor shifts; (3) sufficient-statistic deduplicated unique-state weighted LOOCV ridge + gate selection.
